title: A stale or future-dated symbol_specs row (architecture 6.9 and 7.6)
why: Report 2 sizes with the broker's own figures, so a row older than 7 days means it is not offered until the figures refresh. The boundary second is still fresh; one second more is stale. A row dated more than 5 minutes ahead of our clock is refused as well, and so is a missing row. With the stored 18 Sep cycle otherwise fine, only the broker figures decide.

probes.label: dated 5 minutes ahead of our clock
